justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/toplist/TopListStage.java and TopListWrapper.java, plus the only external caller ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/main/JITWatchUI.java. The target package contains just these two classes; JITWatchUI is the only observed external reference (it creates TopListStage), and no other files import org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.ui.toplist. TopListStage depends on ui.main, model, org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.toplist, util, and JavaFX, while TopListWrapper only wraps ITopListVisitable. This is a small UI feature with one incoming dependency, not evidence of a stable package depending on less-stable packages.
